title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HATCHAM
text: HATCHAM. Supposin' it were inciderism--and supposin' our 'orse was the hobject.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Good gracious!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HATCHAM
text: HATCHAM. That's why I ain't goin' to watch single-handed.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Get back then--get back! [_SIR TRISTRAM and GEORGIANA pace up and down excitedly._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HATCHAM
text: HATCHAM. Right, Sir. There's only one mortal fear I've got about our Dandy.

title: Dandy Dick
text: GEORGIANA _and_ SIR TRISTRAM. What's that?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HATCHAM
text: HATCHAM. He 'asn't found out about 'is tail yet, sir, and when he does it'll fret him, as sure as my name's Bob Hatcham.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Keep the stable pitch dark--he mayn't notice it.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HATCHAM
text: HATCHAM. Not to-night, sir, but he's a proud 'orse and what'll he think of 'isself on the 'ill to-morrow? You and me and the lady, sir--it 'ud be different with us, but how's our Dandy to hide his bereavement? [_HATCHAM goes out of the window with SIR TRISTRAM as THE DEAN enters, followed by BLORE, who carries a lighted lantern._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Looking reproachfully at GEORGIANA._] You have returned, Georgiana?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Yes, thank ye.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. And that animal?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. In our stables, safe and snug.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_With a groan._] Oh!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. You can sleep to-night with the happy consciousness of having sheltered the outcast.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. We're locking up now. The poor children, exhausted with the alarm, beg me to say good-night for them. The fire is quite extinguished.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Yes, sir; but I hear they've just sent into Durnstone hasking for the Military to watch the ruins in case of another houtbreak. It'll stop the wicked Ball at the Hathanaeum, it will! [_Drawing the window curtains._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. [_Having re-entered._] I suppose you want to see the last of me, Jedd.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Mardon!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Don't be unkind, Tris. Where shall we stow the dear old chap, Gus, my boy?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Where shall we stow the dear old chap! I really don't know.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Let me see. We don't want to pitch you out of your loft if we can help it, Gus.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. No, no--we won't do that.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Don't consider me in this manner. But there's Sheba's little cot still standing in the old nursery.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Just the thing for me--the old nursery.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. The old nursery. Toys to play with if you wake early.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Looking round._] Is there anyone else before we lock up? [_BLORE has fastened the window and drawn the curtain._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Put Sir Tristram to bed carefully in the nursery, Blore.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. [_Grasping THE DEAN'S hand._] Good-night, old boy. I'm too done for a hand of Piquet to-night.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I never play cards.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. [_Slapping him on the back._] I'll teach you during my stay at the Deanery.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Helplessly to himself._] Then he's staying with me!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Good-night, George.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Good-night, partner. Heaven bless the little innocent in his cot. [_SIR TRISTRAM goes out with BLORE._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_Calling after him._] Tris! You may take your pipe up with you. We smoke all over the Deanery.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_To himself._] I never smoke! Does _she?_

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_Closes the door, humming a tune merrily._] Tra la, tra la! Now, Mr. Tidd, we'll toddle. Tra la! tra la! [_She stops, looking at THE DEAN, who is muttering to himself._] Gus, I don't like your looks, I shall let the Vet see you in the morning. What's wrong with you? [_THE DEAN shakes his head mournfully, and sinks on the settee._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Money?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. There _are_ bills, which, at a more convenient time, it will be my grateful duty to discharge.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. And you're short?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Short?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Stumped--out of coin--run low. What'll square the bills?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Very little would settle the bills--but--but----

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. I know--the Spire. Why, Gus, you haven't got that thousand.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. There is a very large number of estimable worthy men who do not possess a thousand pounds. With that number I have the mournful pleasure of enrolling myself.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. When's the settling day?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Eh?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. When will you have to fork out?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Unless the restoration is immediately commenced the spire will certainly crumble.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Then it's a match between you and the spire which parts first. Gus, will you let your little sister lend you a hand?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. My dear Georgiana, impossible!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. No, no--not out of my own pocket. Come here. [_She takes his arm and whispers in his ear._] Can you squeeze a pair of ponies?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Can I what?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Can you raise fifty pounds?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Certainly. More than fifty pounds.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. No--no, don't be rash! That's the worst of you beginners. Only fifty by to-morrow morning.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Most assuredly.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Very well then--clap it on to Dandy Dick!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_With horror._] What!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. He's a certainty--if those two buckets of water haven't put him off it! He's a moral--if he doesn't think of his tail coming down the hill. There's nothing like him at the weight. Keep it dark, Gus--don't breathe a word to any of your Canons or Archdeacons, or they'll rush at it and shorten the price for us. Go in, Gus, my boy--take your poor widowed sister's tip and sleep as peacefully as a blessed baby! [_She presses him warmly to her and kisses him._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Extricating himself._] Oh! Mrs. Tidman! Go to your room!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Augustin!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. In the morning I will endeavor to frame some verbal expression of the horror with which I regard your proposal. For the present, you are my parents' child and I trust your bed is well aired.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Oh, very well, Augustin. I've done all I can for the Spire. _Bon soir,_ old boy!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Good-night.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. If you're wiser in the morning just send Blore on to the course and he'll put the money on for you.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Blore! My poor devoted old servant would be lost on a race-course.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Would he! He was quite at home in Tattersall's Ring when I was at St. Marvells last summer.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Blore!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Blore. I recognized the veteran sportsman the moment I came into the Deanery.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. What was my butler doing at St. Marvells Races? _BLORE enters with his lantern._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Investing the savings of your cook and housemaid, of course. You don't think your servants are as narrow as you are!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Oh!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. I beg your pardon, sir, shall I go the rounds, sir? [_THE DEAN gives Blore a fierce look, but BLORE beams sweetly._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Blore!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Mum?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Breakfast at nine, sharp. And pack a hamper with a cold chicken, some French rolls, and two bottles of Heidsieck--label it "George Tidd," and send it on to the Hill. I'll stand the racket. Goodnight. [_She goes out. THE DEAN sinks into a chair and clasps his forehead._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. A dear, 'igh-sperited lady. [_Leaning over THE DEAN._] Aren't you well, sir?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Serpent!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Meanin' _me,_ sir? THE DEAN Lock up; I'll speak to you in the morning. Lock up. [_BLORE goes into the Library, turns out the lamp there, and disappears._ What dreadful wave threatens to engulf the Deanery? What has come to us in a few fatal hours? A horse of sporting tendencies contaminating my stables, his equally vicious owner nestling in the nursery, and my own widowed sister, in all probability, smoking a cigarette at her bedroom window with her feet on the window-ledge! [_Listening._] What's that? [_He peers through the window curtains._] I thought I heard footsteps in the garden. I can see nothing--only the old spire standing out against the threatening sky. [_Leaving the window shudderingly._] The Spire! My principal creditor! My principal creditor, the most conspicuous object in the city! _BLORE re-enters with his lantern, carrying some bank-notes in his hand._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_Laying the notes on the table._] I found these, sir, on your dressing-table--they're bank-notes, sir.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Taking the notes._] Thank you. I placed them there to be sent to the Bank to-morrow. [_Counting the notes._] Ten--ten--twenty--five--five, fifty. Fifty pounds! The very sum Georgiana urged me to--oh! [_To BLORE, waving him away._] Leave me--go to bed--go to bed--go to bed! [_BLORE is going._] Blore!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Sir?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. What made you tempt me with these at such a moment?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Temp' you, sir! The window was hopen, and I feared they might blow away.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Catching him by the coat collar._] Man, what were you doing at St. Marvells Races last summer?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_With a cry, falling on his knees._] Oh, sir! Oh, sir! I knew that 'igh-sperited lady would bring grief and sorrow to the peaceful, 'appy Deanery! Oh, sir, I _'ave_ done a little on my hown account from time to time on the 'ill, halso hon commission for the kitchen!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I knew it--I knew it!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Oh, sir, you are a old gentleman--turn a charitable 'art to the Races! It's a wicious institution what spends more ready money in St. Marvells than us good people do in a year.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Get up, Blore--get up. Oh, Edward Blore, Edward Blore, what weak creatures we are!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. We are, sir--we are--'specially when we've got a tip, sir. Think of the temptation of a tip, sir.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I do, Blore--I do.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. I confess heverything, sir. Bonny Betsy's bound for to win the 'andicap.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. No, no--she isn't.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. She is, sir.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I know better; she can never get down the hill with those legs of hers.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. She can, sir--what's to beat her?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. The horse in my stable--Dandy Dick!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Dandy Dick! That old bit of ma'ogany, sir. They're layin' ten to one against him.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_With hysterical eagerness._] Are they? I'll take it! I'll take it!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Lord love you, sir--fur how much?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Fifty! There's the money. [_Impulsively he crams the notes into BLORE'S hand and then recoils in horror._] Oh! [_Sinks into a chair with a groan._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_In a whisper._] Lor', who'd 'ave thought the Dean was such a ardent sportsman at 'art? He dursn't give me my notice after this. [_To THE DEAN._] Of course it's understood, sir, that we keep our little weaknesses dark. Houtwardly, sir, we remain respectable, and, I 'ope, respected. [_Putting the notes into his pocket._] I wish you good-night, sir. [_He walks to the door. THE DEAN makes an effort to recall him but fails._] And that old man 'as been my pattern and example for years and years! Oh, Edward Blore, your hidol is shattered! [_Turning to THE DEAN._] Good-night, sir. May your dreams be calm and 'appy, and may you have a good run for your money! [_BLORE goes out--THE DEAN gradually recovers his self-possession._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I--I am upset to-night, Blore. Of course you leave this day month. I--I [_looking round._] Blore! He's gone! If I don't call him back the Spire may be richer to-morrow by five hundred pounds. I won't dwell on it. I'll read--I'll read. [_Snatches a book at haphazard from the bookshelf. There is the sound of falling rain and distant thunder._] Rain, thunder. How it assimilates with the tempest of my mind! I'll read. Bless me! This is very strange. [_Reading._] "The Horse and its Ailments, by John Cox, M. R. C. V. S." It was with the aid of this volume that I used to doctor my old mare at Oxford. A leaf turned down. [_Reading._] "Simple remedies for chills--the Bolus." The helpless beast in my stable is suffering from a chill. Good gracious! If I allow Blore to risk my fifty pounds on Dandy Dick, surely it would be advisable to administer this Bolus to the poor animal without delay. [_Referring to the book hastily._] I have these drugs in my chest. There's not a moment to be lost! [_Going to the bell and ringing._] I shall want help. I'll fetch my medicine chest. [_He lays the book upon the table and goes into the Library._ _BLORE enters._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_Looking round._] Where is he? The bell rang. The Dean's puzzling me with his uncommon behavior, that he is. [_THE DEAN comes from the Library, carrying a large medicine chest. On encountering BLORE he starts and turns away his head, the picture of guilt._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Blore, I feel it would be a humane act to administer to the poor ignorant animal in my stable a simple Bolus as a precaution against chill. I rely upon your aid and discretion in ministering to any guest in the Deanery.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_In a whisper._] I see, sir--you ain't going to lose half a chance for to-morrow, sir--you're a knowin' one, sir, as the sayin' goes!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Shrinking from BLORE with a groan._] Oh! [_He places the medicine chest on the table and takes up the book. Handing the book to BLORE with his finger on a page._] Fetch these humble but necessary articles from the kitchen--quick. I'll mix the Bolus here. [_BLORE goes out quickly._] It is exactly seven and twenty years since I last approached a horse medically. [_He takes off his coat and lays it on a chair, then rolls his shirt-sleeves up above his elbows and puts on his glasses._] I trust that this Bolus will not give the animal an unfair advantage over his competitors. I don't desire that! I don't desire that! [_BLORE re-enters carrying a tray, on which are a small flour-barrel and rolling-pin, a white china basin, a carafe of water, a napkin, and the book. THE DEAN recoils, then guiltily takes the tray from BLORE and puts it on the table._] Thank you.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_Holding on to the window curtain and watching THE DEAN._] His eyes is awful; I don't seem to know the 'appy Deanery when I see such proceedings a'goin' on at the dead of night. [_There is a heavy roll of thunder--THE DEAN mixes a pudding and stirs it with the rolling-pin._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. The old half-forgotten time returns to me. I am once again a promising youth at college.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_To himself._] One would think by his looks that he was goin' to poison his family instead of--Poison! Poison! Oh, if hanything serious 'appened to the hanimal in our stable there would be nothing in the way of Bonny-Betsy, the deservin' 'orse I've trusted with my 'ard-earned savings!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I am walking once again in the old streets at Oxford, avoiding the shops where I owe my youthful bills. Bills! [_He pounds away vigorously with the rolling-pin._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_To himself._] Where's the stuff I got a month ago to destroy the hold black retriever that fell hill?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Bills!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. The dog died--the poison's in my pantry--it couldn't have got used for cooking purposes.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I see the broad meadows and the tall Spire of the college--the Spire! Oh, my whole life seems made up of Bills and Spires!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_To himself._] I'll do it! I'll do it! [_Unseen by The Dean he quickly and quietly steals out by the door._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Where are the drugs--the drugs? [_Opening the medicine chest and bending down over the bottles he pours some drops from a bottle into the basin._] [_Counting._] Three--four--five--six. [_He replaces the bottle and takes another._] How fortunate some animals are! [_Counting._] One--two--three, four. It's done! [_Taking up the medicine chest he goes with it into the Library._ _As he disappears BLORE re-enters stealthily fingering a small paper packet._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_In a whisper._] Strychnine! [_There is a heavy roll of thunder--BLORE darts to the table, empties the contents of the packet into the basin, and stirs vigorously with the rolling-pin._] I've cooked Dandy Dick! I've cooked Dandy Dick! [_He moves from the table in horror._] Oh! I'm only a hamatoor sportsman and I can't afford a uncertainty. [_As THE DEAN returns, BLORE starts up guiltily._] Can I help you any more, Sir?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. No, remove these dreadful things, and don't let me see you again to-night! [_Sits with the basin on his knees, and proceeds to roll the paste._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_Removing the tray._] It's only an 'orse--it's only an 'orse! But after to-morrow I'll retire from the Turf, if only to reclaim 'im. [_He goes out._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Putting on his coat._] I don't contemplate my humane task with resignation. The stable is small, and if the animal is restive we shall be cramped for room. [_The rain is heard._] I shall get a chill too. [_Seeing SIR TRISTRAM'S coat and cap lying upon the settee._] I am sure Mardon will lend me this gladly. [_Putting on the coat, which completely envelops him._] The animal may recognize the garment, and receive me with kindly feeling. [_Putting on the sealskin cap, which almost conceals his face._] Ugh! why do I feel this dreadful sinking at the heart? [_Taking the basin and turning out the lamp._] Oh! if all followers of the veterinary science are as truly wretched as I am, what a noble band they must be! [_The thunder rolls as he goes through the window curtains. SIR TRISTRAM then enters quietly, smoking, and carrying a lighted candle._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. All right; fire still burning. [_Blowing out the candle._] I shall doze here till daybreak. What a night! I never thought there was so much thunder in these small country places. [_GEORGIANA, looking pale and agitated, and wearing a dressing-gown, enters quickly, carrying an umbrella and a lighted candle._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Which is the nearer way to the stable? I must satisfy myself--I must--I must! [_Going to the door._]

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. [_Rising suddenly._] Hullo!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_Shrieks with fright._] Ah!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Hush!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_Holding out her umbrella._] Stand where you are or I'll fire! [_Recognizing SIR TRISTRAM._] Tris!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Why, George!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Oh, Tris, I've been dreaming! [_Falling helplessly against Sir Tristram, who deposits her in a chair._] Oh! oh! oh! Don't look at me! I'm overtrained. I shall be on my legs again in a minute. [_She opens her umbrella and hides herself behind it, sobbing violently._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. [_Standing over the umbrella in great concern._] My goodness! George, whatever shall I do? Shall I trot you up and down outside?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Be quiet! [_Sobbing._] What are you fooling about here for? Why can't you lie quietly in your cot?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Confound that cot! Why, it wouldn't hold my photograph. Where are you going?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Into the stable to sit with Dandy. The thunder's awful in my room; when it gets tired it seems to sit down on my particular bit of roof. I did doze once, and then I had a frightful dream. I dreamt that Dandy had sold himself to a circus, and that they were hooting him because he had lost his tail. There's an omen!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Don't, don't--be a man, George, be a man!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_Shutting her umbrella._] I know I'm dreadfully effeminate. There--Tidd's himself again!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Bravo!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Ah, Tris--don't think me soft, old man. I'm a lonely, unlucky woman, and the tail end of this horse is all that's left me in the world to love and to cling to!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. No, by Jove! I'm not such a mean cur as that! Swop halves and take his head, George, my boy.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Not I! I'm like a doating mother to my share of Dandy, and it's all the dearer because it's an invalid. I'm off.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Come along! [_Turning towards the window, she following him, he suddenly stops and looks at her, and seizes her hand._] George, I never guessed that you were so tender-hearted.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Well, I'm not.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. And you've robbed me to-night of an old friend--a pal.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. I--what d'ye mean?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. I mean that I seem to have dropped the acquaintance of George Tidd, Esquire, forever.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Tris--no.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. I have--but I've got an introduction to his twin-sister, Georgiana!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_Snatching her hand away angrily._] Stay where you are; I'll nurse my half alone. [_She goes towards the window, then starts back._] Hush!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. What's the matter?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Didn't you hear something?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Where?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_Pointing to the window._] There.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. [_Peeping through the curtains._] You're right. Some people moving about the garden.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Tris! The horse!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. They're not near the stables. They're coming in here. Hush! We'll clear out and watch! [_SIR TRISTRAM takes the candlestick and they go out leaving the room in darkness. The curtains at the window are pushed aside, and SALOME and SHEBA enter; both in their fancy dresses._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. [_In a rage, lighting the candles on the mantelpiece._] Oh! oh! oh!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Oh! oh! No ball after all!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. If we only had a brother to avenge us!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. I shall try and borrow a brother to-morrow!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. Cold, wretched, splashed, in debt--for nothing!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. To think that we've had all the inconvenience of being wicked and rebellious and have only half done it!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. This comes of stooping to the Military!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. It serves us right--we've been trained for clergymen's wives. I hate Nugent Darbey. I hope he may grow bald early!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. Gerald Tarver's nose is inclined to pink--may it deepen and deepen till it frightens cows! [_Voices are heard from the curtained window recess._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: DARBEY
text: DARBEY. [_Outside._] Miss Jedd--Sheba!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: TARVER
text: TARVER. [_Outside._] Pray hear two wretched men! Miss Jedd!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. [_In a whisper._] There they are.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Shall we grant them a dignified interview?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. Yes. Curl your lip, Sheba.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. You curl your lip better than I--I'll dilate my nostrils. [_SALOME draws aside the curtain. TARVER and DARBEY enter. They are both very badly and shabbily dressed as Cavaliers._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: TARVER
text: TARVER. [_A most miserable object, carrying a carriage umbrella._] Oh, don't reproach us, Miss Jedd. It isn't our fault that the Military were summoned to St. Marvells.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: DARBEY
text: DARBEY. You don't blame officers and gentlemen for responding to the sacred call of duty?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. We blame officers for subjecting two motherless girls to the shock of alighting at the Durnstone Athenaeum to find a notice on the front door: "Ball knocked on the head--Vivat Regina."

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. We blame gentlemen for inflicting upon us the unspeakable agony of being jeered at by boys.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: TARVER
text: TARVER. I took the address of the boy who suggested that we should call again on the fifth of November. It is on the back of your admission card.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: DARBEY
text: DARBEY. Everything will be done. We shall both wait on the boy's mother for an explanation.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: TARVER
text: TARVER. Oh, smile on us once again, Miss Jedd--a forced, hollow smile, if you will--only smile. Salome! _GEORGIANA enters._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Salome! Sheba!

title: Dandy Dick
text: SALOME _and_ SHEBA. Aunt!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. You bad girls!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. [_Weeping._] No, Aunt, no!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Not bad. Aunt--trustful and confiding.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_Advancing to TARVER._] How dare you encourage these two simple children to enjoy themselves! How dare you take them out--without their Aunt! Do you think _I_ can't keep a thing quiet?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. They didn't even ask Papa's permission!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. Poor Papa!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Poor, dear Papa!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_Shaking TARVER._] I'm speaking to you--Field-Marshal.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: TARVER
text: TARVER. Madam, you are addressing an invalid.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: DARBEY
text: DARBEY. We shall be happy to receive your representative in the morning. At present we are on duty.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: TARVER
text: TARVER. On heavy duty.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: DARBEY
text: DARBEY. Guarding the ruins of the "Swan" Inn. You mustn't distract our attention.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Guarding the ruins of the "Swan," are you? [_Calling._] Tris! Sir Tristram! [_SIR TRISTRAM appears._] Tris, I'm a feeble woman, but I hope I've a keen sense of right and wrong. Run these outsiders into the road, and let them guard their own ruins. [_SALOME and SHEBA shriek, and throw themselves at the feet of TARVER and DARBEY. clinging to their legs._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. No, no. Spare him!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. You shall not harm a hair of their heads. [_SIR TRISTRAM twists TARVER'S wig round so that it covers his face. The gate bell is heard ringing violently._

title: Dandy Dick
text: GEORGIANA, SALOME _and_ SHEBA. What's that?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. It will wake Papa!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Stop the bell! [_GEORGIANA runs to the door and opens it._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. [_To TARVER and DARBEY._] Fly! [_TARVER and DARBEY disappear through the curtains at the window._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. [_Falling into SALOME'S arms._] We have saved them!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Oh, Tris, your man from the stable!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Hatcham!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_Calling._] Hatcham! [_HATCHAM, carrying the basin with the bolus, runs in breathlessly--followed by BLORE._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HATCHAM
text: HATCHAM. Oh, Sir Tristram!

title: Dandy Dick
text: GEORGIANA _and_ SIR TRISTRAM. What is it?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HATCHAM
text: HATCHAM. The villain that set fire to the "Swan," sir--in the hact of administering a dose to the 'orse!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Nobbling our Dandy?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Where is the scoundrel?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HATCHAM
text: HATCHAM. Topping the constable's collared him, Sir--he's taken him in a cart to the lock-up!

title: Dandy Dick
text: GEORGIANA _and_ SIR TRISTRAM. Oh!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_In agony._] They've got the Dean!

title: Dandy Dick
text: END OF THE SECOND ACT.

title: Dandy Dick
text: THE THIRD ACT.

title: Dandy Dick
text: The first scene is the interior of a country Police Station, a quaint old room with plaster walls, oaken beams, and a gothic mullioned window looking on to the street. A massive door, with a small sliding wicket and an iron grating, opens to a prisoner's cell. The room is partly furnished as a kitchen, partly as a police station, a copy of the Police Regulations and other official documents and implements hanging on the wall. It is the morning after the events of the previous act. _HANNAH, a buxom, fresh-looking young woman, in a print gown, has been engaged in cooking while singing gayly._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_Opening a door and calling with a slight dialect._] Noah darling!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. [_From another room--in a rough, country voice._] Yaas!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. You'll have your dinner before you drive your prisoner over to Durnstone, won't ye, darling?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Yaas!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_Closing the door._] Yaas! Noah's in a nice temper to-day over summat. Ah well, I suppose all public characters is liable to irritation. [_There is a knock at the outer door. HANNAH opening it, sees BLORE with a troubled look on his face._] Well I never! Mr. Blore from the Deanery! Come in! You might knock me down with a----!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_Entering and shaking hands mournfully._] How do you do, Mrs. Topping?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. And how is the dear Dean, bless him; the sweetest soul in the world?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_To himself._] Good gracious! She doesn't know of hour misfortune. [_To HANNAH._] I--I 'aven't seen him this morning!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Well, this is real kind of you, calling on an old friend, Edward. When I think that I were cook at the Deanery seven years, and that since I left you, to get wedded, not a soul of you has been nigh me, it do seem hard.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Well, you see, 'Annah, the kitchen took humbrage at your marryin' a policeman at Durnstone. It was regarded as a messyliance.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Well, now Mr. Topping's got the appointment of Head Constable at St. Marvells, what's that regarded as?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. A rise on the scales, 'Annah, a decided rise--but still you've honly been a week in St. Marvells and you've got to fight your way hup.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. I think I'm as hup as ever I'm like to be.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. 'Owever, Jane and Sarah and Willis the stable boy 'ave hunbent so far as to hask me to leave their cards, knowin' I was a callin'. [_He produces from an old leather pocket-book three very dirty pieces of paste-board, which he gives to HANNAH._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_Taking them in her apron with pride._] Thank 'em kindly. When's their evening?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. We receive on Toosdays, at the side gate. And 'ow are you, my dear? [_Kissing her cheek._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Don't, Edward Blore!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Don't! When you was Miss Hevans there wasn't these social barriers, 'Annah!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Shut up! Noah's jealous of the very apron-strings what go round my waist. I'm not so free and 'andy with my kisses now, I can tell you.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Then "what is friendship but a name!" But Mr. Topping isn't indoors now, surely!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_Nodding her head._] Um--um!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Why, he took a man up last night!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. What of it?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Why, I thought that when hany harrest was made in St. Marvells, the prisoner was lodged here honly for the night and that the 'ead Constable 'ad to drive 'im over to Durnstone Police Station the first thing in the morning.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. That's the rule, but Noah's behindhand to-day, and ain't going into Durnstone till after dinner.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Then the prisoner is now hon the premises!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Yes, he's in our cell.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Ah! And where is the hapartment in question?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. The cell? That's it!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_Looking round in horror._] Oh!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. The "Strong-box" they call it in St. Marvells.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Oh, my goodness, honly fancy! [_Whimpering to himself._] And 'im accustomed to his shavin' water at h'eight and my kindly hand to button his gaiters. Oh, here's a warnin'!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Whatever is the matter with you, Edward?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. 'Annah, 'Annah, my dear, it's this very prisoner what I 'ave called on you respectin'.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Oh, then the honor ain't a compliment to me, after all, Mr. Blore?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. I'm killing two birds with one stone, my dear.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_Throwing the cards into BLORE'S hat._] You can take them back to the Deanery with Mrs. Topping's comps.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_Shaking the cards out of his hat and replacing them in his pocket-book._] I will leave them hon you again to-morrow, 'Annah. But, 'Annah deary, do you know that this hunfortunate man was took in our stables last night.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. No, I never ask Noah nothing about Queen's business. He don't want _two_ women over him!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Then you 'aven't seen the miserable culprit?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Lor' no. I was in bed hours when Noah brought 'im 'ome. I take no interest in it all. They tell us it's only a wretched poacher or a petty larcery we'll get in St. Marvells. My poor Noah ain't never likely to have the chance of a horrid murder in a place what returns a Conservative. My joint's burning. [_Kneeling to look into the oven._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. But, 'Annah, suppose this case you've got 'old of now is a case what'll shake old England to its basis! Suppose it means columns in the paper with Topping's name a-figurin'! Suppose as family readin', it 'old its own with divorce cases!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Hullo! You know something about this arrest, you do!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. No, no, I don't! I merely said suppose. I merely wish to encourage you, 'Annah; to implant an 'ope that crime may brighten your wedded life.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_Sitting at the table and referring to an official book._] The man was found trespassing in the Deanery Stables with intent--refuses to give his name or any account of 'isself.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_To himself._] If I could honly find hout whether Dandy Dick had any of the medicine it would so guide me at the Races. What am I to do? It doesn't appear that the 'orse in the stables--took it, does it?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_Looking up sharply._] Took what?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Er--took fright. You're sure there's no confession of any sort, 'Annah dear? [_As he is bending over HANNAH, NOAH TOPPING appears. NOAH is a dense-looking ugly countryman, with red hair, a bristling heard, and a vindictive leer. He is dressed in ill-fitting clothes, as a rural Police Constable._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. [_Fiercely._] 'Annah!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_Starting and replacing the book._] Oh don't! This is Mr. Blore from the Deanery come to see us--an old friend o' mine! [_BLORE advances to NOAH with a nervous smile, extending his hand._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. [_Taking BLORE'S hand and holding it firmly._] A friend of hern is a friend o' mian!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. I 'ope so, Mr. Topping. I thank you.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. She's gettin' me a lot o' nice noo friends this week, since we coom to St. Marvells.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Of course, dear 'Annah was a lovin' favorite with heverybody.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Ay. Well then, as her friends be mian, I'm takin' the liberty, one by one, of gradually droppin' on 'em all.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_Getting his hand away._] Dear me!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. And if I catch any old fly a buzzin' round my lady I'll venture to break his 'ead in wi' my staff!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Oh, Noah!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_Preparing to depart._] I--I merely called to know if hanything had been found hout about the ruffian took in our stables last night!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Is that your business?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. It--it's my master's business.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. He's the De-an, ain't he?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Yes, Noah, of course.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. [_Fiercely._] Shut oop, darlin'. Very well, then--give Mr. Topping's respects to the Dean, and say I'll run up to the Deanery and see him after I've took my man over to Durnstone.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Thank you--I 'ope the Dean will be at 'ome. Good-day, 'Annah! Good-day, Mr. Topping! [_Offering his hand, into which NOAH significantly places his truncheon. BLORE goes out quickly._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_Whimpering._] Oh, Noah, Noah, I don't believe as we shall ever get a large circle of friends round us!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Now then! [_Selecting a pair of handcuffs and examining them critically._] Them'll do. [_Slipping them into his pocket, and turning upon HANNAH suddenly._] 'Annah!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Yes, Noahry----

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Brighten oop, my darlin', the little time you 'ave me at 'ome with you.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Yes, Noahry. [_She bustles about and begins to lay the cloth._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. I'm just a' goin' round to the stable to put old Nick in the cart.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Oh, dont'ee trust to Nick, Noah dear--he's such a vicious brute. Kitty's safer in the cart.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Shut oop, darlin'. Nick can take me on to the edge o' the hill in half the time.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. The hill!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Ah, what d'ye think I've put off taking my man to Durnstone to now for? Why, I'm a goin' to get a glimpse of the racin', on my way over. [_Opening the wicket in the cell door and looking in._] There he is! Sulky! [_To HANNAH._] Hopen the hoven door, 'Annah, and let the smell of the cookin' get into him.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Oh, no, Noah--it's torture!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Do as I tell'ee. [_She opens the oven door._] Torture! Of course it's torture! That's my rule! Whenever I get a 'old of a darned obstinate creature wot won't reveal his hindentity I hopens the hoven door. [_He goes out into the street, and as he departs, the woful face of THE DEAN appears at the wicket, his head being still enveloped in the fur cap._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_Shutting the oven door._] Not me! Torturing prisoners might a' done for them Middling Ages what Noah's always clattering about, but not for my time o' life. I'll shut that wicket. [_Crossing close to the wicket, her face almost comes against THE DEAN'S. She gives a cry._] The Dean!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Oh! [_He disappears._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Oh, no! Not my old master! Never the master! [_Tottering to the wicket and looking in._] Master! Look at me! It's 'Annah, your poor faithful servant, 'Annah! [_The face of THE DEAN re-appears._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_In a deep sad voice._] Hannah Evans.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. It's 'Annah Topping, Knee Evans, wife o' the Constable what's goin' to take you to cruel Durnstone. [_Sinking weeping upon the ground at the door._] Oh, Mr. Dean, sir, what have you been up to? What have you been up to? What have you been up to?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Woman, I am the victim of a misfortune only partially merited.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_On her knees, clasping her hands._] Tell me what you've done, Master dear; give it a name, for the love of goodness

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. My poor Hannah, I fear I have placed myself in an equivocal position.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_With a shriek of despair._] Ah!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Be quiet, woman!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Is it a change o' cooking that's brought you to such ways? I cooked for you for seven 'appy years!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Sniffing._] Alas! you seem to have lost none of your culinary skill.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Master, are you hungry?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I am sorely tried by your domestic preparations.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_With clenched hands and a determined look._] Oh! [_Quickly locking and bolting the street door._] Noah can't put that brute of a horse to under ten minutes. The dupplikit key o' the Strong Box! [_Producing a large key, with which she unlocks the cell door._] Master, you'll give me your patrol not to cut, won't you?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Under any other circumstances, Hannah, I should resent that insinuation.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Don't resent nothing! Shove! Shove your hardest, Dean dear! [_Pulling the door which opens sufficiently to let out THE DEAN._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_As he enters the room._] Good day, Hannah; you have bettered yourself, I hope?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_Hysterically flinging herself upon THE DEAN._] Oh, Master, Master!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Putting her from him sternly._] Hannah! Mrs. Topping!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Oh, I know, I know, but crime levels all, dear sir!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. You appear to misapprehend the precise degree of criminality which attaches to me, Mrs. Topping. In the eyes of that majestic, but imperfect instrument, the law, I am an innocent if not an injured man.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Ah, stick to that, sir! Stick to it, if you think it's likely to serve your wicked ends! [_Placing bread with other things on the table._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. My good woman, a single word from me to those at the Deanery, would instantly restore me to home, family, and accustomed diet.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Ah, they all tell that tale what comes here. Why don't you send word, Dean dear?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Because it would involve revelations of my temporary moral aberration!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_Putting her apron to her eyes with a howl._] Owh!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Because I should return to the Deanery with my dignity--that priceless possession of man's middle age!--with my dignity seriously impaired!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Oh, don't, sir, don't!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. How could I face my simple children who have hitherto, not unreasonably, regarded me as faultless? How could I again walk erect in the streets of St. Marvells with my name blazoned on the Records of a Police Station of the very humblest description? [_Sinking into a chair and snatching up a piece of breads which he begins munching._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_Wiping her eyes._] Oh, sir, it's a treat to hear you, compared with the hordinary criminal class. But, master, dear, though my Noah don't recognize you--through his being a stranger to St. Marvells--how'll you fare when you get to Durnstone?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I have one great buoyant hope--that a word in the ear of the Durnstone Superintendent will send me forth an unquestioned man. You and he will be the sole keepers of my precious secret. May its possession be a lasting comfort to you both.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Master, is what you've told me your only chance of getting off unknown?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. It is the sole remaining chance of averting a calamity of almost national importance.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Then you're as done as that joint in my oven!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Woman!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. The Superintendent at Durnstone--John Ruggles--also the two Inspectors, Whitaker and Parker----

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Well!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Them and their wives and families are chapel folk!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Aghast._] No!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Yes. [_THE DEAN totters across to a chair, into which he sinks with his head upon the table._] Master! Listen!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. It's all over! It's all over!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. No, no--Listen! I was well fed and kept seven years at the Deanery--I've been wed to Noah Topping eight weeks--that's six years and ten months' lovin' duty doo to you and yours before I owe nothing to my darling Noah. Master dear, you shan't be took to Durnstone!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Silence! Hannah Topping, formerly Evans, it is my duty to inform you that your reasoning does more credit to your heart than to your head.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. I can't help that. The Devil's always in a woman's heart because it's the warmest place to get to! [_Taking a small key from the table drawer._] Here, take that! [_Pushing the key into the pocket of his coat._] When you once get free from my darling Noah that key unlocks your handcuffs!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Handcuffs!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. How are you to get free, that's the question now, isn't it? I'll tell you. My Noah drives you over to Durnstone with old Nick in the cart.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Old Nick!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. That's the horse. Now Nick was formerly in the Durnstone Fire Brigade, and when he 'ears the familiar signal of a double whistle you can't hold him in. There's the whistle. [_Putting it into THE DEAN'S pocket._] Directly you turn into Pear Tree Lane, blow once and you'll see Noah with his nose in the air, pullin' fit to wrench his 'ands off. Jump out--roll clear of the wheel--keep cool and 'opeful and blow again. Before you can get the mud out of your eyes Noah and the horse and cart will be well into Durnstone, and may Providence restore a young 'usband safe to his doatin' wife!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Hannah! How dare you! [_Recoiling horror-stricken._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_Crying._] Oh--ooh--ooh!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Is this the fruit of your seven years' constant cookery at the Deanery?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Oh dear! I wouldn't have done it, only this is your first offence!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. My first offence, oh!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. You're not too old; I want to give you another start in life!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Another start! Woman, do you think I've no conscience? Do you think I don't realize the enormity of the--of the difficulties in alighting from a vehicle in rapid motion?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_Opening the oven and taking out a small joint in a baking tin, which she places on the table._] It's 'unger what makes you feel conscientious!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Waving her away._] I have done with you!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. With me, sir--but not with the joint! You'll feel wickeder when you've had a little nourishment. [_He looks hungrily at the dish._] That's right, Dean, dear--taste my darling Noah's favorite dish.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Advancing towards the table._] Oh, Hannah Topping--Hannah Topping! [_Clutching the carving-knife despairingly._] I'll have no more women cooks at the Deanery! This reads me a lesson. [_Sitting and carving with desperation._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Don't stint yourself, sir. You can't blow that whistle on an empty frame. [_THE DEAN begins to eat._] Don't my cooking carry you back, sir? Oh, say it do!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Ah, if every mouthful would carry me back one little hour I would finish this joint! [_NOAH TOPPING, unperceived by HANNAH and THE DEAN, climbs in by the window, his eyes bolting with rage--he glares round the room, taking in everything at a glance._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. [_Under his breath._] My man o' mystery--a waited on by my nooly made wife--a heating o' my favorite meal. [_Touching HANNAH on the arm, she turns and faces him, speechless with fright._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Still eating._] If my mind were calmer this would be an all-sufficient repast. [_HANNAH tries to speak, then clasps her hands and sinks on her knees to NOAH._] Hannah, a little plain cold water in a simple tumbler, please.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. [_Grimly--folding his arms._] 'Annah, hintrodooce me. [_HANNAH gives a cry and clings to NOAH'S legs._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Calmly to NOAH._] Am I to gather, constable, from your respective attitudes that you object to these little kindnesses extended to me by your worthy wife?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. I'm wishin' to know the name o' my worthy wife's friend. A friend o' hern is a friend o' mian.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Noahry! Noahry!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. She's gettin' me a lot o' nice noo friends since we coom to St. Marvells.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Noahry! I made this gentleman's acquaintance through the wicket, in a casual way.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Ay. Cooks and railins--cooks and railins! I might a guessed my wedded life 'ud a coom to this.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. He spoke to me just as a strange gentleman ought to speak to a lady! Didn't you, sir--didn't you?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Hannah, do not let us even under these circumstances prevaricate; such is not quite the case! [_NOAH advances savagely to THE DEAN. There is a knocking at the door.--NOAH restrains himself and faces THE DEAN._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Noa, this is neither the toime nor pla-ace, wi' people at the door and dinner on t' table, to spill a strange man's blood.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I trust that your self-respect as an officer of the law will avert anything so unseemly.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Ay. That's it! You've touched me on my point o' pride. There ain't another police-station in all Durnstone conducted more strict and rigid nor what mian is, and it shall so continue. You and me is a goin' to set out for Durnstone, and when the charges now standin' agen you is entered, it's I, Noah Topping, what'll hadd another! [_There is another knock at the door._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Noah!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. The charge of allynating the affections o' my wife, 'Annah!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Horrified._] No, no!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Ay, and worse--the embezzlin' o' my mid-day meal prepared by her 'ands. [_Points into the cell._] Go in; you 'ave five minutes more in the 'ome you 'ave ruined and laid waste.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Going to the door and turning to NOAH._] You will at least receive my earnest assurance that this worthy woman is extremely innocent?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Hinnocent? [_Points to the joint on the table._] Look theer! [_THE DEAN, much overcome, disappears through the cell door, which NOAH closes and locks. The knock at the door is repeated. To HANNAH, pointing to the outer door._] Hunlock that door!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_Weeping._] Oh, Noahry, you'll never be popular in St. Marvells.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Hunlock that door! [_HANNAH unlocks the door, and admits GEORGIANA and SIR TRISTRAM, both dressed for the race-course._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Dear me! Is this the Police-Station?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Yes, lady. Take a chair, lady, near the fire. [_To SIR TRISTRAM._] Sit down, sir.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. This is my first visit to a police-station, my good woman; I hope it will be the last.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Oh, don't say that, ma'am. We're honly hauxilliary 'ere, ma'am--the Bench sets at Durnstone.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. I must say you try to make everybody feel at home. [_HANNAH curtseys._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. It's beautifully Arcadian.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_To HANNAH._] Perhaps this is only a police-station for the young?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. No, ma'am, we take ladies and gentlemen like yourselves.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. [_Who has not been noticed, surveying GEORGIANA and SIR TRISTRAM, gloomily._] 'Annah, hintrodooce me.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_Facing NOAH._] Good gracious! What's that! Oh, good-morning.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. 'Annah's a gettin' me a lot o' nice noo friends this week since we coom to St. Marvells.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Noah, Noah--the lady and gentlemen is strange.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Ho!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Are you the man in charge here?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Ay; are you seeing me on business or pleasure?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Do you imagine people come here to see you?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Noa--they generally coom to see my wife. 'Owever, if it's business [_pointing to the other side of the room_] that's the hofficial side--this is domestic. You'll hall kindly move over.

title: Dandy Dick
text: SIR TRISTRAM _and_ GEORGIANA. Oh, certainly. [_Changing their seats._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Now, look here, my man. This lady is Mrs. Tidman. Mrs. Tidman is the sister of Dr. Jedd, the Dean of St. Marvells.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_With a gasp._] Oh!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. There's something wrong with your wife.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Ay. She's profligate--proceedins are pendin'!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_To SIR TRISTRAM._] Strange police station! My flesh creeps.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. [_To NOAH._] Well, my good man, to come to the point. My poor friend and this lady's brother, Dr. Jedd, the Dean, you know--has mysteriously and unaccountably disappeared.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Vanished.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Gone.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Absconded.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Absconded! How dare you.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Respectable man, was 'e?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. What do you mean?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. This lady is his sister!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Now, look 'ere--it's no good a gettin' 'asty and irritable with the law. I'll coom over to yer, officially. [_Putting the baking tin under his arm he crosses over to SIR TRISTRAM and GEORGIANA._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. [_Putting his handkerchief to his face._] Don't bring that horrible odor of cooking over here.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Take it away! What is it?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. It's evidence against my profligate wife. [_SIR TRISTRAM and GEORGIANA exchange looks of impatience._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Do you realize that my poor brother the Dean is missing?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Ay. Touching this missin' De-an.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. I left him last night to retire to rest.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. This morning he is not to be found!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Ay. 'As it struck you to look in 'is bed?

title: Dandy Dick
text: GEORGIANA _and_ SIR TRISTRAM. Of course!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Everybody did that!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. One 'ud a done. It's only confusin'--hall doin' it! Money matters right or wrong? [_GEORGIANA puts her handkerchief to her eyes._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Do put your questions more feelingly! This is his sister--I am his friend!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. You will push yourselves forrard. Had he anything on his mind?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Yes!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Then I've got a the'ry.

title: Dandy Dick
text: GEORGIANA _and_ SIR TRISTRAM. What is it?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. A the'ry that will put you all out o' suspense!

title: Dandy Dick
text: GEORGIANA _and_ SIR TRISTRAM. Yes, yes!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. I've been a good bit about, I read a deal, and I'm a shrewd experienced man. I should say this is nothin' but a hordinary case of sooicide. [_GEORGIANA sits faintly._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. [_Savagely to NOAH._] Get out of the way! Georgiana?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Oh, Tris, if this were true how could we break it to the girls?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. I could run oop, durin' the evenin', and break it to the girls.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. [_Turns upon NOAH._] Look here, all you've got to do is to hold your tongue and take down my description of the Dean, and report his disappearance at Durnstone. [_Pushing him into a chair._] Go on! [_Dictating._] "Missing. The Very Reverend Augustin Jedd, Dean of St. Marvells." Poor Gus! Poor Gus!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_Softly to GEORGIANA._] Lady, lady. [_NOAH prepares to write, depositing the baking-tin on the table._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_Turning._] Eh?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Hush! Listen to me! [_Speaks to GEORGIANA excitedly._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. [_To NOAH._] Have you got that?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. [_Writing laboriously with his legs curled round the chair and his head on the table._] Ay. I'm spelling it my own way.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Poor dear old Gus! [_Dictating._] "Description!"

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Oh noa!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. "Description!"

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. I suppose he was jest the hordinary sort o' lookin' man.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. No, no! "Description!"

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_Turning from HANNAH, excitedly._] Description--a little, short, thin man, with black hair and a squint!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. [_To GEORGIANA._] No, no, he isn't.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Yes, he is!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Georgiana! What are you talking about?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. I'm Gus's sister--I ought to know what he's like!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Good heavens, Georgiana--your mind is not going?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_Clutching SIR TRISTRAM'S arm and whispering in his ear, as she points to the cell door._] He's in there!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Eh!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Gus is the villain found dosing Dandy Dick last night!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. [_Falling back._] Oh! [_HANNAH seizes SIR TRISTRAM and talks to him rapidly._] [_To NOAH._] What have you written?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. I've written "Hanswers to the name o' Gus!"

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_Snatching the paper from him._] It's not wanted. I've altered my mind. I'm too busy to bother about him this week.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. What! Hafter wasting my time?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Look here--you're the constable who took the man in the Deanery Stables last night?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Ay. [_Looking out of the window._] There's my cart outside ready to take the scoundrel over to Durnstone.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. I should like to see him.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. You can view him passin' out. [_He tucks the baking-tin under his arm and goes up to the cell door._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_To herself._] Oh, Gus, Gus!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. [_Unlocking the door._] I warn yer. 'E's a awful looking creature.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. I can stand it; I love horrors! [_NOAH goes into the cell, closing the door after him._ Tris!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Georgiana!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. What was my brother's motive in bolusing Dandy last night?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. I can't think. The first thing to do is to get him out of this hole. This good woman has arranged for his escape.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. But we can't trust to Gus rolling out of a flying dogcart! Why, it's as much as I could do!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Oh, yes, lady, he'll do it. I've prewided for everything. Don't betray him to Noah! There's another--a awfuller charge hangin' over his reverend 'ead.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Another charge!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Another! Oh Tris! To think my own stock should run vicious like this.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Hush, lady! [_NOAH comes out of the cell with THE DEAN, who is in handcuffs._

title: Dandy Dick
text: GEORGIANA _and_ SIR TRISTRAM. Oh!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Raising his eyes, sees SIR TRISTRAM and GEORGIANA, and recoils with a groan, sinking on to a chair._] Oh!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Oop you get!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. No, no, stay! I am the owner of the horse stabled at the Deanery. I make no charge against this wretched person. [_To THE DEAN._] Oh man, man!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I was discovered administering to a suffering beast a simple remedy for chills. I am an unfortunate creature. Do with me what you will.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. The analysis hasn't come home from the chemist's yet. Is this the truth?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Yes.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. [_To NOAH._] Release this man.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Release him! He was found trespassin' in the stables of the la-ate De-an, who has committed sooicide.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Oh! I----

title: Dandy Dick
text: SIR TRISTRAM, GEORGIANA _and_ HANNAH. Hush!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. The Diseased De-an is the honly man wot can withdraw one charge----

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I--listen!

title: Dandy Dick
text: SIR TRISTRAM, GEORGIANA _and_ HANNAH. Hush!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. And I'm the honly man wot can withdraw the other.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. You? Get out!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Get out!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. I charge this person unknown with allynating the affections o' my wife while I was puttin' my 'orse to. And I'm goin' to drive him over to Durnstone with the hevidence.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Oh lady, lady, it's appearances what is against us.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. [_Through the opening of the door._] Woa! Steady there! Get back!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_Whispering to THE DEAN._] I am disappointed in you, Angustin. Have you got this wretched woman's whistle?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Yes.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. [_Softly to THE DEAN._] Oh Jedd, Jedd--and these are what you call Principles! Have you got the key of your handcuffs?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Yes.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. [_Appearing in the doorway._] Time's oop. Coom on!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. May I say a few parting words in the home I have apparently wrecked?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Say' em and 'a done.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. In setting out upon a journey, the termination of which is problematical, I desire to attest that this erring constable is the husband of a wife from whom it is impossible to withhold respect, if not admiration.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. You 'ear' im!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. As for my wretched self, the confession of my weaknesses must be reserved for another time--another place. [_To GEORGIANA._] To you, whose privilege it is to shelter in the sanctity of the Deanery, I give this earnest admonition. Within an hour from this terrible moment, let the fire be lighted in the drawing-room--let the missing man's warm bath be waiting for its master--a change of linen prepared. Withhold your judgments. Wait.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. This is none of your business. Coom on.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I am ready! [_NOAH takes him by the arm and leads him out._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Oh, what am I to think of my brother?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_Kneeling at GEORGIANA'S feet._] Think! That he's the beautifullest, sweetest man in all Durnshire!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Woman!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. It's I and my whistle and Nick the fire-brigade horse what'll bring him back to the Deanery safe and unharmed. Not a soul but we three'll ever know of his misfortune. [_Listening._] Hark! They're off!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. [_Outside._] Get up, now! Get-oop, old girl!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_With a cry._] Ah! [_Rushing to the door and looking out._] He's done for!

title: Dandy Dick
text: GEORGIANA _and_ SIR TRISTRAM. Done for!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. The Dean can whistle himself blue! Noah's put Kitty in the cart, and left Old Nick at home!

title: Dandy Dick
text: THE END OF THE FIRST SCENE.

title: Dandy Dick
text: _The second scene is the Morning Room at the Deanery again._

title: Dandy Dick
text: _SALOME and SHEBA are sitting there gloomily._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. Poor Papa!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Poor dear Papa!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. He must return very soon--he must!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. He must! In the meantime it is such a comfort to feel that we have no cause for self-reproach.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. But the anxiety is terribly wearing.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Nothing is so weakening, Salome.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. Sheba, dear.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. [_Clinging to SALOME._] If I should pine and ultimately die of this suspense I want you to have my workbox.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. [_Shaking her head and sadly turning away._] Thank you, dear, but if Papa is not home for afternoon tea you will outlive me. [_Turning towards the window as MAJOR TARVER and MR. DARBEY appear outside._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: DARBEY
text: DARBEY. [_Outside._] Miss Jedd! Miss Jedd!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. Sheba! Here are Gerald Tarver and Mr. Darbey!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Oh, the presumption! Open the window and dare them to enter! [_SALOME unfastens the window._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: DARBEY
text: DARBEY. [_Outside._] Thank you. Don't be shocked when you see Tarver. _TARVER and DARBEY enter, dressed for the Races, but DARBEY is supporting TARVER, who looks extremely weakly._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: TARVER
text: TARVER. Pardon this informal method of presenting ourselves.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. You do well, gentlemen, to intrude upon two feeble women at a moment of sorrow.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. One step further, and I shall ask Major Tarver, who is nearest the bell, to ring for help. [_TARVER sinks into a chair._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: DARBEY
text: DARBEY. [_Standing by the side of TARVER._] There now. The fact is. Miss Jedd, that Tarver is in an exceedingly critical condition. Feeling that he has incurred your displeasure he has failed even in the struggle to gain the race-course. I have taken him to Dr. Middleton and I explained that Major Tarver loved with a passion [_looking at SHEBA_] second only to my own.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. [_Sitting comfortably on the settee._] Oh, we cannot listen to you, Mr. Darbey.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Go on, sir, if you can. [_The two girls exchange looks._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: DARBEY
text: DARBEY. The Doctor made a searching examination of the Major's tongue and diagnosed that, unless the Major at once proposed to the lady in question and was accepted, three weeks or a month at the seaside would be absolutely imperative. Shall I continue?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. Oh, certainly. I am helpless.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. We are curious to see to what lengths you will go.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: DARBEY
text: DARBEY. The pitiable condition of my poor friend speaks for itself.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. I beg your pardon--it does nothing of the kind.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: TARVER
text: TARVER. [_Rising with difficulty and approaching SALOME._] Salome--I have loved you distractedly for upwards of eight weeks.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. [_Going to him._] Oh, Major Tarver, let me pass; [_holding his coat firmly_] let me pass, I say.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: TARVER
text: TARVER. Unless you push me, never!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Spare me this scene, Mr. Darbey. [_DARBEY follows SHEBA across the room._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: TARVER
text: TARVER. To a man in my condition love is either a rapid and fatal malady, or it is an admirable digestive. Accept me, and my merry laugh once more rings through the Mess Room. Reject me, and my collection of vocal music, loose and in volumes, will be brought to the hammer, and the bird, as it were, will trill no more.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. And is it really I who would hush the little throaty songster?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: TARVER
text: TARVER. Certainly. [_Taking a sheet of paper from his pocket._] I have the Doctor's certificate to that effect. [_Both reading the certificate they walk into Library._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Oh, Mr. Darbey, I have never thought of marriage seriously.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: DARBEY
text: DARBEY. People never do till they _are_ married.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. But think, only think of my age.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: DARBEY
