text: DARBEY. Pardon me, Sheba--but what is your age?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Oh, it is so very little--it is not worth mentioning. Cannot we remain friends and occasionally correspond?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: DARBEY
text: DARBEY. Well, of course--if you insist----

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. No, no, I see that is impracticable. It must be wed or part. All I ask is time--time to ponder over such a question, time to know myself better.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: DARBEY
text: DARBEY. Certainly, how long?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Give me two or three minutes. Hush! [_They separate as TARVER and SALOME re-enter the room. TARVER is glaring excitedly and biting his nails._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: TARVER
text: TARVER. I never thought I should live to be accepted by anyone. I shall buy some gay songs. Er--when can I see the Dean?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. Oh, don't!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: TARVER
text: TARVER. Salome!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. Papa has been out all night.

title: Dandy Dick
text: DARBEY _and_ TARVER. All night?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. Isn't it terrible! Oh, what do you think of it, Mr. Darbey?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: DARBEY
text: DARBEY. Shocking, but we oughtn't to condemn him unheard.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. Condemn my Papa!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. [_At the window._] Here's Aunt Georgiana!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: DARBEY
text: DARBEY. Eh! Look out, Tarver. [_Going out quickly._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. [_Pulling TARVER after her._] Come this way and let us take cuttings in the conservatory. [_They go out._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Mr. Darbey! Mr. Darbey, wait for me--I have decided. _Yes._ [_She goes out by the door as GEORGIANA enters excitedly at the window._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_Waving her handkerchief._] Come on, Tris! The course is clear! Mind the gate-post! Hold him up! Now give him his head! _SIR TRISTRAM and HATCHAM enter by the window carrying THE DEAN. They all look as though they have been recently engaged in a prolonged struggle._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Put him down!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Put him down!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HATCHAM
text: HATCHAM. That I will, ma'am, and gladly. [_They deposit THE DEAN in a chair and GEORGIANA and SIR TRISTRAM each seize a hand, feeling THE DEAN'S pulse, while HATCHAM puts his hand on THE DEAN'S heart._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Opening his eyes._] Where am I now?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. He lives! Hurrah! Cheer man, cheer! SIR TRISTRAM _and_ HATCHAM [_Quietly._] Hurrah! [_To HATCHAM._] We can't shout here; go and cheer as loudly as you can in the roadway by yourself.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HATCHAM
text: HATCHAM. Yes, Sir. [_HATCHAM runs out at the window._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Gradually recovering._] Georgiana--Mardon.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. How are you, Jedd, old boy?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. How do you feel now, Gus?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Torn to fragments.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. So you are. Thank heaven, he's conscious.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I feel as if I had been walked over carefully by a large concourse of the lower orders!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. So you have been. Thank heaven, his memory is all right. [_HATCHAM'S voice is heard in the distance cheering. They all listen._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. That's Hatcham; I'll raise his wages.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Do I understand that I have been forcibly and illegally rescued?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. That's it, old fellow.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Who has committed such a reprehensible act?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. A woman who would have been a heroine in any age--Georgiana!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Georgiana, I am bound to overlook it, in a relative, but never let this occur again.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Tell him.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. You found out that that other woman's plan went lame, didn't you?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I discovered its inefficacy, after a prolonged period of ineffectual whistling.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. But we ascertained the road the genial constable was going to follow. He was bound for the edge of the hill, up Pear Tree Lane, to watch the Races. Directly we knew this, Tris and I made for the Hill. Bless your soul, there were hundreds of my old friends there--welshers, pick-pockets, card-sharpers, all the lowest race-course cads in the kingdom. In a minute I was in the middle of 'em, as much at home as a Duchess in a Drawing-room.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. A Queen in a Palace!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Boadicea among the Druids! "Do you know me?" I holloaed out. Instantly there was a cry of "Blessed if it ain't George Tidd!" Tears of real joy sprang to my eyes--while I was wiping them away Tris had his pockets emptied and I lost my watch.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Ah, Jedd, it was a glorious moment!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Tris made a back, and I stood on it, supported by a correct-card merchant on either side. "Dear friends," I said; "Brothers! I'm with you once again." You should have heard the shouts of honest welcome. Before I could obtain silence my field glasses had gone on their long journey. "Listen to me," I said. "A very dear relative of mine has been collared for playing the three-card trick on his way down from town." There was a groan of sympathy. "He'll be on the brow of the Hill with a bobby in half-an-hour," said I, "who's for the rescue?" A dead deep silence followed, broken only by the sweet voice of a young child, saying, "What'll we get for it?" "A pound a-piece," said I. There was a roar of assent, and my concluding words, "and possibly six months," were never heard. At that moment Tris' back could stand it no longer, and we came heavily to the ground together. [_Seizing THE DEAN by the hand and dragging him up._] Now you know whose hands have led you back to your own manger. [_Embracing him._] And oh, brother, confess--isn't there something good and noble in true English sport after all?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Every abused institution has its redeeming characteristic. But whence is the money to come to reward these dreadful persons? I cannot reasonably ask my girls to organize a bazaar or concert.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Concert! I'm a rich woman.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Rich!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Well, I've cleared fifteen hundred over the Handicap.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Recoiling._] No! Then the horse who enjoyed the shelter of the Deanery last night----

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Dandy Dick!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Won!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. In a common canter! All the rest nowhere, and Bonny Betsy walked in with the policeman.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_To himself._] Five hundred pounds towards the Spire! Five hundred! Oh, where is Blore with the good news!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Look at him! Lively as a cricket!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Sir Tristram, I am under the impression that your horse swallowed reluctantly a small portion of that bolus last night before I was surprised and removed.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. By the bye, I am expecting the analysis of that concoction every minute.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Spare yourself the trouble--the secret is with me. I seek no acknowledgment from either of you, but in your moment of deplorable triumph remember with gratitude the little volume of "The Horse and its Ailments" and the prosaic name of its humane author--John Cox. [_He goes out through the Library._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. But oh, Tris Mardon, what can I ever say to you?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Anything you like except "Thank you!"

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Don't stop me? Why, you were the man who hauled Augustin out of the cart by his legs!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Oh, but why mention such trifles?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. They're not trifles. And when his cap fell off, it was you--brave fellow that you are--who pulled the horse's nose-bag over my brother's head so that he shouldn't be recognized.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. My dear Georgiana, these are the common courtesies of every-day life.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. They are acts which any true woman would esteem. Gus won't readily forget the critical moment when all the cut chaff ran down the back of his neck--nor shall I.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Nor shall I forget the way in which you gave Dandy his whisky out of a soda water bottle just before the race.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. That's nothing--any lady would do the same.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Nothing! You looked like the Florence Nightingale of the paddock! Oh, Georgiana, why, why, why won't you marry me?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Why!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Why?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Why! Because you've only just asked me, Tris! [_Goes to him cordially._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. But when I touched your hand last night, you reared!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Yes, Tris, old man, but love is founded on mutual esteem; last night you hadn't put my brother's head in that nose-bag. [_They go together to the fireplace, he with his arm round her waist._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. [_Looking in at the door._] How annoying! There's Aunt and Sir Tristram in this room--Salome and Major Tarver are sitting on the hot pipes in the conservatory--where am I and Mr. Darbey to go? Papa! Come back! [_She withdraws quickly as THE DEAN enters through the Library carrying a paper in his hand; he has now resumed his normal appearance._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Home! What sonorous music is in the word! Home, with the secret of my sad misfortune buried in the bosoms of a faithful few. Home, with my family influence intact! Home, with the sceptre of my dignity still tight in my grasp! What is this I have picked up on the stairs? [_Reads with a horrified look, as HATCHAM enters at the window._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HATCHAM
text: HATCHAM. Beg pardon, Sir Tristram.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. What is it?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HATCHAM
text: HATCHAM. The chemist has just brought the annal_i_sis.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Where is he? [_SIR TRISTRAM and GEORGIANA go out at the window, following HATCHAM._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. It is too horrible! [_Reading._] "Debtor to Lewis Isaacs, Costumier to the Queen, Bow Street--Total, Forty pounds, nineteen!" There was a fancy masked ball at Durnstone last night! Salome--Sheba--no, no!

title: Dandy Dick
text: SALOME _and_ SHEBA. [_Bounding in and rushing at THE DEAN._] Papa, Papa!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. Our own Papa!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Papsey! [_SALOME seizes his hands, SHEBA his coat-tails, and turn him round violently._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. Our parent returned!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Papsey--come back!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Stop!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. Papa, why have you tortured us with anxiety?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Where have you been, you naughty man?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Before I answer a question, which, from a child to its parent, partakes of the unpardonable vice of curiosity, I demand an explanation of this disreputable document. [_Reading._] "Debtor to Lewis Isaacs, Costumier to the Queen."

title: Dandy Dick
text: SALOME _and_ SHEBA. Oh! [_SHEBA sits aghast on the table--SALOME distractedly falls on the floor._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I will not follow this legend in all its revolting intricacies. Suffice it, its moral is inculcated by the mournful total. Forty pounds, nineteen! Imps of deceit! [_Looking from one to the other._] There was a ball at Durnstone last night. I know it.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Spare us!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. You couldn't have been there, Papa!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. There! I trust I was better--that is, otherwise employed. [_Referring to the bill._] Which of my hitherto trusted daughters was a lady--no, I will say a person--of the period of the French Revolution? [_SHEBA points to SALOME._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. And a flower-girl of an unknown epoch. [_SALOME points to SHEBA._] To your respective rooms! [_The girls cling together._] Let your blinds be drawn. At seven porridge will be brought to you.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. Papa!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Go!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Papsey!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Go!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. Papa, we, poor girls as we are, can pay the bill.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. You cannot--go!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. Through the kindness of our Aunt----

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. We have won fifty pounds.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. What!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. At the Races!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Recoiling._] You too! You too drawn into the vortex! Is there no conscience that is clear--is there no guilessness left in this house, with the possible exception of my own!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. [_Sobbing._] We always knew a little more than you gave us credit for, Papa.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Handing SHEBA the bill._] Take this horrid thing--never let it meet my eyes again. As for the scandalous costumes, they shall be raffled for in aid of local charities. Confidence, that precious pearl in the snug shell of domesticity, is at an end between us. I chastise you both by permanently withholding from you the reason of my absence from home last night. Go! [_The girls totter out as SIR TRISTRAM enters quickly at the window, followed by GEORGIANA, carrying the basin containing the bolus. SIR TRISTRAM has an opened letter in his hand._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Good heavens, Jedd! the analysis has arrived!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I am absolutely indifferent!

title: Dandy Dick
text: GEORGIANA _and_ SIR TRISTRAM. Indifferent!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_To GEORGIANA._] How dare you confront me without even the semblance of a blush--you who have enabled my innocent babies, for the first time in their lives, to discharge one of their own accounts.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. There isn't a blush in our family--if there were, you'd want it. [_SHEBA and SALOME appear outside the window, looking in._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Jedd, you were once my friend, and you are to be my relative.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Looking at GEORGIANA._] My sister! [_To SIR TRISTRAM._] I offer no opposition.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. But not even our approaching family tie prevents my designating you as one of the most atrocious conspirators known in the history of the Turf.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Conspirator!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. As the owner of one-half of Dandy Dick, I denounce you!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. As the owner of the other half, _I_ denounce you!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. You! _SHEBA and SALOME enter, and remain standing in the recess, listening._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. The chief ingredient of your infernal preparation is known.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. It contains nothing that I would not cheerfully administer to my own children.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_In horror._] Oh!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. I believe you. [_Pointing to the paper._] Strychnine! Sixteen grains!

title: Dandy Dick
text: SALOME _and_ SHEBA. [_Clinging to each other terrified._] Oh!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Strychnine! Summon my devoted servant Blore, in whose presence the innocuous mixture was compounded. [_GEORGIANA rings the bell. The girls hide behind the window curtains._] This analysis is simply the pardonable result of over-enthusiasm on the part of our local chemist.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. You're a disgrace to the pretty little police station where you slept last night! [_BLORE enters and stands unnoticed._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I will prove that in the Deanery Stables the common laws of hospitality have never been transgressed. Give me the bowl! [_GEORGIANA hands THE DEAN the basin from the table._] A simple remedy for a chill.

title: Dandy Dick
text: GEORGIANA _and_ SIR TRISTRAM. Strychnine--sixteen grains!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I, myself, am suffering from the exposure of last night. [_Taking the remaining bolus and opening his mouth._] Observe me!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. [_Rushing forward, snatching the basin from THE DEAN and sinking on to his knees._] No, no! Don't, don't! You wouldn't 'ang the holdest servant in the Deanery.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Blore!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. I did it! I 'ad a honest fancy for Bonny Betsy, and I wanted this gentleman's 'orse out of the way. And while you was mixing the dose with the best ecclesiastical intentions, I hintroduced a foreign element.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Pulling BLORE up by his coat collar._] Viper!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Oh sir, it was hall for the sake of the Dean.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. The Dean?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. The dear Dean had only Fifty Pounds to spare for sporting purposes, and I thought a gentleman of 'is 'igh standing ought to have a certainty.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Jedd!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Augustin!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I can conceal it no longer--I--I instructed this unworthy creature to back Dandy Dick on behalf of the Restoration Fund.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. [_Shaking BLORE._] And didn't you do it?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. No.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Why not? In the name of that tottering Spire, why not?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Oh, sir, thinking as you'd given some of the mixture to Dandy I put your cheerful little offering on to Bonny Betsy. [_SALOME and SHEBA disappear._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Oh! [_To BLORE._] I could have pardoned everything but this last act of disobedience. You are unworthy of the Deanery. Leave it for some ordinary household.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. If I leave the Deanery, I shall give my reasons, and then what'll folks think of you and me in our old age?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. You wouldn't spread this tale in St. Marvells?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: BLORE
text: BLORE. Not if sober, sir--but suppose grief drove me to my cups?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. I must save you from intemperance at any cost. Remain in my service--a sad, sober and, above all, a silent man! [_SALOME and SHEBA appear as BLORE goes out through the window._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. Papa!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. To your rooms! I am distracted!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. Major Tarver and Mr. Darbey!----

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. If you have sufficiently merged all sense of moral rectitude as to declare that I am not at home, do so.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. No, no. Papa; we have accidentally discovered that you, our parent, have stooped to deception, if not to crime.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Staggering back._] Oh!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. We are still young--the sooner, therefore, we are removed from any unfortunate influence the better.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SALOME
text: SALOME. We have an opportunity of beginning life afresh.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SHEBA
text: SHEBA. These two gallant gentlemen have proposed for us.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Then I _am_ at home. Where are they? [_He goes out rapidly, followed by SALOME and SHEBA. Directly they have disappeared, NOAH TOPPING, looking dishevelled, rushes in at the window, with HANNAH clinging to him._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. [_Glaring round the room._] Is this 'ere the Deanery? [_GEORGIANA and SIR TRISTRAM come to him._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Noahry, Noah, come back!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Theer's been a man rescued from my lawful custody while my face was unofficially held downwards in the mud. The villain has been traced back to the Deanery.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Go away!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. Come away!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. The man was a unknown lover of my nooly made wife!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. You mustn't bring your domestic affairs here; this is a subject for your own fireside of an evening. [_THE DEAN appears outside the window with SALOME, SHEBA, TARVER and DARBEY._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Outside._] Come in, Major Tarver--come in, Mr. Darbey!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. That's his voice! _THE DEAN enters, followed by SALOME, TARVER, SHEBA and DARBEY._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. [_Confronting THE DEAN._] My man.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. No, no, Noahry!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. You're speaking to Dr. Jedd, the Dean of St. Marvells.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. I'm speaking to the man I took last night--the culprit as 'as allynated the affections of my wife.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Wait--one moment! [_Going out at the window._ [_SALOME and TARVER go into the Library and sit at the writing-table. DARBEY sits in an arm-chair with SHEBA on the arm._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Mildly._] Do not let us chide a man who is conscientious even in error. [_Looking at HANNAH._] I think I see Hannah Evans, once an excellent cook under this very roof.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. I'm Mrs. Topping now, sir--bride o' the constable. And oh, do forgive him--he's a mass o' ignorance.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Coom away! [_HANNAH returns to NOAH. as SIR TRISTRAM re-enters with HATCHAM._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. [_To HATCHAM._] Hatcham--[_pointing to THE DEAN_]--Is that the man you and the Constable secured in the stable last night?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HATCHAM
text: HATCHAM. That, sir! Bless your 'art, sir, that's the Dean 'imself.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. That'll do.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HATCHAM
text: HATCHAM. [_To NOAH._] Why, our man was a short, thin individual! [_HATCHAM goes out at the window._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_To NOAH._] I trust you are perfectly satisfied.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. [_Wiping his brow and looking puzzled._] I'm doon.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Don't trouble further. I withdraw unreservedly any charge against this unknown person found on my premises last night. I attribute to him the most innocent intentions. Hannah, you and your worthy husband will stay and dine in my kitchen. Good afternoon.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. Is it a 'ot dinner?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Hot--with ale.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: NOAH
text: NOAH. [_Turning angrily to HANNAH._] Now then, you don't know a real gentleman when you see one. Why don't 'ee thank the Dean warmly?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: HANNAH
text: HANNAH. [_Kissing THE DEAN'S hands with a curtsey._] Thank you, sir.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Benignly._] Go--go. I take a kindly interest in you both. [_They back out, bowing and curtseying._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Well, Gus, you're out of all your troubles. Are you happy?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Happy! My family influence gone forever--my dignity crushed out of all recognition--the genial summer of the Deanery frosted by the winter of Deceit.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Ah, Gus, when once you lay the whip about the withers of the horse called Deception he takes the bit between his teeth, and only the devil can stop him--and he'd rather not. Shall I tell you who has been riding the horse hardest?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Who?

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. The Dean.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. Georgiana! I'm surprised at you. [_SHEBA sits at the piano and plays a bright air softly--DARBEY standing behind her--SALOME and TARVER stand in the archway._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. [_Slapping THE DEAN on the back._] Look here, Augustin, George Tidd will lend you that thousand for the poor, innocent old Spire.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Taking her hand._] Oh, Georgiana!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. On one condition--that you'll admit there's no harm in our laughing at a Sporting Dean.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. No, no--I cannot allow it!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Tris! My brother Gus doesn't want us to be merry at his expense. [_They both laugh._

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: THE DEAN
text: THE DEAN. [_Trying to silence them._] No, no! I forbid it! Hush!

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: SIR TRISTRAM
text: SIR TRISTRAM. Why, Jedd, there's no harm in laughter, for those who laugh or those who are laughed at.

title: Dandy Dick
speaker: GEORGIANA
text: GEORGIANA. Provided always--firstly, that it is Folly that is laughed at and not Virtue; secondly, that it is our friends who laugh at us, [_to the audience_] as we hope they all will, for our pains.

title: Dandy Dick
text: THE END
